articles.title: Monkey Heist in Court! Primate Snatches ₹2 Lakh Bag, Showers Cash From Tree in Bulandshahr
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre incident unfolded at the Bulandshahr court premises on Saturday when a monkey snatched a bag containing ₹2 lakh from a man who had arrived to complete a property registration process.

body.html:
A bizarre incident unfolded at the Bulandshahr court premises on Saturday when a monkey snatched a bag containing ₹2 lakh from a man who had arrived to complete a property registration process.

The unexpected incident created panic and amusement among those present after the monkey climbed a tree with the bag and began throwing currency notes from above.

According to reports, a man who had come to the chambers of advocates Sohanpal and Aamir Khan for the registration of a sale deed was handed ₹2 lakh in cash to purchase stamp papers. The money was placed in a bag and given to Ravindra Lodhi, alias Raju.

As Ravindra stepped out of the chamber carrying the bag, a monkey suddenly snatched it and ran away. Eyewitness and advocate Ashutosh Singh said the monkey climbed a nearby tree with the bag. When Ravindra and others attempted to chase it, the monkey began pulling out and throwing currency notes from the tree.

As notes rained down, a crowd quickly gathered to collect the scattered cash. The man who had brought the money was left distressed as people rushed to retrieve the notes.

With the help of advocates, court staff and members of the public, most of the cash was recovered from beneath the tree after considerable effort. Officials said ₹1.98 lakh was successfully collected, while some currency notes were torn by the monkey during the chaos.

As a result, around ₹2,000 could not be recovered. No injuries were reported, and the unusual incident soon became the talk of the court premises.

#Bulandshahr #MonkeyHeist #ViralNews #CourtPremises #BizarreIncident

articles.title: Parking Dispute Turns Violent in Kasol, Tourist Allegedly Opens Fire on Local Youth
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A parking dispute in Himachal Pradesh's popular tourist destination of Kasol escalated into violence after a tourist allegedly opened fire on a local youth, leaving him injured and triggering panic in the crowded market area.

body.html:
A parking dispute in Himachal Pradesh's popular tourist destination of Kasol escalated into violence after a tourist allegedly opened fire on a local youth, leaving him injured and triggering panic in the crowded market area.

The incident, which was captured on video and has since gone viral on social media, unfolded in full public view as tourists, shopkeepers and local residents witnessed a verbal argument spiral into a serious criminal act.

According to police, the confrontation began over vehicle parking in the busy Kasol market. What started as a heated exchange between a group of tourists and local youths soon turned into a physical altercation.

During the clash, one of the tourists allegedly pulled out a pistol and fired at a local youth, injuring him. The gunshot caused panic across the market, with people rushing for safety as chaos erupted in the area.

The injured youth was immediately rushed to a hospital, where he is currently undergoing treatment.

Eyewitnesses described scenes of confusion and fear following the firing. Several people rushed to assist the injured youth, while others attempted to calm the situation as crowds gathered at the scene.

Videos circulating online allegedly show a tourist wearing a white shirt openly brandishing a pistol in the middle of the market shortly after the firing. The footage shows the armed man standing on the road with the weapon in his hand while onlookers kept their distance.

Witnesses claimed the accused continued waving the pistol in public for some time, creating fear among tourists, traders and local residents. According to those present, his companions eventually intervened and pulled him away from the scene before leaving the area.

Following information about the firing, police launched a swift operation and arrested four accused in connection with the case. The pistol allegedly used in the incident has been seized, along with the vehicle in which the accused were travelling.

Kullu Superintendent of Police Madan Lal Kaushal said the incident stemmed from a dispute over parking in Kasol. He confirmed that four accused have been arrested and that the weapon and vehicle linked to the incident have been recovered.

A case has been registered under relevant legal provisions and further investigation is underway. Police are analysing CCTV footage, viral videos and witness statements to reconstruct the sequence of events and determine whether additional charges will be invoked.

The officer said that any attempt to disturb law and order in Dev Bhoomi Himachal Pradesh would be dealt with strictly.

The incident has once again raised concerns about violent confrontations in tourist destinations, with a minor parking dispute allegedly escalating into a shooting that left a local youth injured and sparked widespread outrage across social media.

#Kasol #HimachalPradesh #ParkingDispute #Gunfire #ViralVideo

articles.title: Manali: Viral Video Shows Driver Attacking Truck, Then Shopkeeper’s Family; Accused Absconding
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking road rage incident in Himachal Pradesh's Manali has sparked outrage after videos of two violent attacks allegedly involving the same accused went viral on social media.

body.html:
A shocking road rage incident in Himachal Pradesh's Manali has sparked outrage after videos of two violent attacks allegedly involving the same accused went viral on social media. Manali Police have registered criminal cases and launched a search operation to arrest the accused, identified as Sanjay Kumar, who is currently absconding.

According to a complaint filed at Manali Police Station on May 29, Prem Chand, a resident of Gahar village in Kullu district, was transporting tiles from Kullu to Leh in his truck (HP-34E-8542) along with conductor Thakur Das. Around 6 pm, near Hotel Neelam in Rangri, a Hyundai Venue (HP-58A-9691) driven by Sanjay Kumar of Rangri allegedly overtook the truck and suddenly stopped in front of it, blocking the road.

The complainant alleged that Sanjay Kumar began abusing him and arguing aggressively. He then allegedly took out a crowbar/sickle-like weapon from his vehicle and attacked the truck, smashing its windows. The accused also allegedly snatched the truck's ignition key before fleeing the spot. The entire incident was captured on video by bystanders and later went viral on social media.

Fortunately, neither the truck driver nor the conductor sustained any injuries. Two eyewitnesses reportedly confirmed the sequence of events.

Based on the complaint and available evidence, Manali Police registered an FIR under Sections 126(2) (wrongful restraint), 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace), 324(2) (mischief causing damage to property), and 351(2) (criminal intimidation) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). DSP Manali KD Sharma confirmed that an investigation is underway.

In a separate incident shortly after the road rage attack, the accused Sanjay Kumar, along with his associate Deshraj, allegedly entered a shop on Kanyal Road in Rangri and attacked shopkeeper Anil Kumar, his wife, and an employee with sticks and clubs. According to the complaint, the accused started a fight without provocation and assaulted the victims before vandalising the shop.

The complainant alleged that Sanjay Kumar had previously visited the shop, demanded goods without payment, and threatened him whenever he refused. Police suspect the attack may have been linked to this ongoing dispute.

The shopkeeper, his wife, and the employee sustained injuries and are currently undergoing treatment. Police have registered another case under relevant sections and initiated further legal action.

As videos of both incidents continue to circulate online, demands for strict action against the accused have intensified on social media. Police have assured that efforts are underway to trace and arrest the accused and that strict legal action will be taken in accordance with the law.

#Manali #RoadRage #ViralVideo #HimachalPradesh #CrimeNews

articles.title: Young Biker Killed, Child Critically Injured After Collision With Police Officer’s Car
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident in Lucknow left a young motorcyclist dead and a 10-year-old boy critically injured, triggering hours of protests and a major traffic blockade on Hardoi Road.

body.html:
A tragic road accident in Lucknow left a young motorcyclist dead and a 10-year-old boy critically injured, triggering hours of protests and a major traffic blockade on Hardoi Road.

The accident occurred around 3:40 pm near the Bajnagar underpass in the Dubagga police station area when a Creta car collided head-on with a motorcycle carrying two people.

The deceased has been identified as Sahil, a resident of Amethia Salempur. Reports indicate he was between 23 and 25 years old. The injured child has been identified as 10-year-old Anjan, while some local reports identified the boy as Mohd. Maaz. The child was rushed to hospital and remains in critical condition.

Head-On Collision Leaves Rider Dead

According to eyewitnesses, the collision was extremely severe. Sahil was allegedly thrown into the air by the impact and suffered fatal head injuries. He died on the spot, while the child riding with him sustained serious injuries.

The motorcycle was badly damaged, and the front portion of the Creta car was also crushed in the crash.

Villagers and bystanders immediately gathered at the scene and detained the occupants of the vehicle before handing them over to police.

SI and Wife Taken Into Custody

According to police, the vehicle was linked to Akash Singh, a 2023-batch sub-inspector currently posted at the Sadar police station in Hardoi.

Police said Akash Singh had travelled to Lucknow's SSF headquarters with his wife, Jahnavi, and was returning to Hardoi when the accident occurred.

However, eyewitnesses claimed the Creta was being driven by the officer's wife while the sub-inspector was seated in the passenger seat wearing his police uniform. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the crash.

News of Sahil's death quickly spread to his village, located around four kilometres from the accident site. Family members and villagers rushed to the scene and blocked the Dubagga-Hardoi Road in protest.

The demonstrators raised slogans against the police and placed several demands before the administration, including:
1. Immediate arrest of those responsible for the crash
2. ₹1 crore compensation for the victim's family
3. A government job for one member of Sahil's family

The blockade caused a traffic jam stretching nearly a kilometre and disrupted movement on the route for around three to four hours.

Sole Breadwinner of Family

Family members said Sahil was the only son of his parents and the sole breadwinner of the household. He reportedly worked as a shuttering engineer and supported his mother and five sisters.

Relatives also said his father is battling cancer, making Sahil's death a devastating blow to the family.

Senior police officers, including Shakeel Ahmed and Rajkumar, reached the spot and held discussions with the protesters. The road blockade was lifted only after officials assured the family of a fair investigation and efforts to secure compensation.

Police have taken the accused occupants of the vehicle into custody and said further action will be based on the findings of the investigation.

#Lucknow #RoadAccident #HardoiRoad #Dubagga

articles.title: CCTV Captures Brutal Assault on SP Women’s Wing Leader Inside Her Home
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A women’s wing leader of the Samajwadi Party was allegedly assaulted inside her residence in Chandauli district, prompting police to register an FIR against five people, including members of the family of a former local leader.

body.html:
A women’s wing leader of the Samajwadi Party was allegedly assaulted inside her residence in Chandauli district, prompting police to register an FIR against five people, including members of the family of a former local leader.

The victim, Gargi Patel, district president of the party’s women’s wing in Chandauli, alleged that she was attacked at her home in Madiya village under the Mughalsarai Kotwali area on Thursday.

According to police and the complainant, former Kashi Vidyapeeth block head Pyarelal Yadav had visited Patel’s residence for a meeting related to a property dealing business in which both were reportedly partners. During the meeting, Yadav’s wife, son and daughter allegedly arrived at the house, triggering a confrontation.

The dispute soon escalated into a violent altercation. CCTV footage from the residence allegedly shows Patel being dragged by her hair, repeatedly kicked and punched, and assaulted with a table. According to the complaint, the accused initially left the premises but later returned and allegedly attacked her again. They also allegedly attempted to assault Patel’s daughter before leaving.

The footage further shows an elderly family member attempting to intervene and calm the situation. However, he was allegedly threatened with similar consequences if he interfered.

Patel claimed the accused entered her home and first assaulted her children before turning on her when she tried to stop them.

“They hit me with kicks, punches, a study table and an iron rod,” she alleged, adding that a financial dispute linked to their business partnership may have been the motive behind the attack.

The SP leader also alleged that certain political figures may have fuelled misunderstandings within the Yadav family, although she did not name anyone.

Following the incident, Patel’s daughter informed the police. Officers rushed to the spot and shifted the injured leader to a district hospital, where she is undergoing treatment. Patel reportedly suffered multiple injuries and was seen bleeding after the assault.

Additional Superintendent of Police Anant Chandra Shekhar said an FIR was registered immediately after the complaint was received.

“The victim has informed us that there was an ongoing business-related dispute between the parties. Five people have been named in the FIR, and all aspects of the case are being investigated,” he said.

Police are examining CCTV footage and other evidence to establish the exact sequence of events and determine the motive behind the alleged assault. Further investigation is underway.

#Chandauli #GargiPatel #SamajwadiParty #UttarPradesh #CCTV

articles.title: Toilet Utensil Wash Row on Duronto Express Sparks Massive Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major controversy has erupted over the quality and hygiene of food served on Indian trains after a viral video allegedly showed catering staff washing utensils inside a train toilet on the LTT–Ernakulam Duronto Express.

body.html:
A major controversy has erupted over the quality and hygiene of food served on Indian trains after a viral video allegedly showed catering staff washing utensils inside a train toilet on the LTT–Ernakulam Duronto Express.

Following the video’s circulation on social media, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) issued a notice to Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC), seeking clarification over the incident.

The case is linked to train number 12223, which operates between Lokmanya Tilak Terminus and Ernakulam. The viral clip allegedly shows catering staff cleaning utensils inside a restroom compartment of the train, triggering outrage among passengers and social media users.

FSSAI has reportedly termed the matter a serious violation of food safety and hygiene norms. Sources said the authority has sought a factual report from IRCTC and asked how such an incident was allowed to occur.

The controversy has once again raised concerns over the cleanliness standards maintained in railway catering services. Passengers have repeatedly complained in the past about unhygienic food handling, poor sanitation, and low-quality meals served on trains.

Under Schedule 4 of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011, all food preparation, handling, cleaning, and dishwashing activities must be conducted in hygienic conditions.

The regulations strictly prohibit any practice that could contaminate food, utensils, or food-contact surfaces. According to FSSAI guidelines, washing utensils in train toilets is a direct violation of food safety standards and can pose serious health risks to passengers.

According to sources, FSSAI has asked IRCTC to verify the authenticity of the viral video and provide details about the steps being taken to prevent similar incidents in the future.

While no detailed official statement has yet been issued by the Railways or IRCTC, reports suggest that an internal inquiry has already been initiated.

Indian Railways has previously claimed that it modernised kitchens, introduced centralised food units, and strengthened monitoring mechanisms to improve catering standards. However, this latest controversy is expected to intensify scrutiny over railway food hygiene practices.

#IndianRailways #IRCTC #FSSAI #DurontoExpress #TrainFood

articles.title: Guard Accused of Beating Visitor in Front of Wife and Child
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young man was allegedly assaulted by a security guard at Janeshwar Mishra Park in Lucknow on Wednesday after an argument reportedly broke out during ticket checking at Gate No. 2. According to eyewitnesses, the man had visited the park with his wife and child after purchasing tickets.

body.html:
A young man was allegedly assaulted by a security guard at Janeshwar Mishra Park in Lucknow on Wednesday after an argument reportedly broke out during ticket checking at Gate No. 2.

According to eyewitnesses, the man had visited the park with his wife and child after purchasing tickets. During the visit, an altercation allegedly erupted between the young man and a guard over ticket verification.

As the dispute escalated, the guard allegedly abused the man, dragged him to the ground by his collar, and assaulted him with his shoes. A video of the incident has now surfaced on social media and is rapidly going viral.

In the video, the man can be seen being dragged on the ground while his wife and child scream and cry nearby. Bystanders reportedly continued filming the incident, while no one intervened for a considerable time.

It has also been alleged that after the assault, the guards hurriedly sent the young man away in an e-rickshaw to prevent the situation from escalating further. The identity of the victim has not been disclosed so far.

LDA Removes Accused Guard

Following the viral video, the Lucknow Development Authority took cognizance of the matter and removed the accused guard from duty as a preliminary action.

Police Claim ‘Pre-Existing Dispute’ Between Couple

In a statement, the Uttar Pradesh Police said the viral video from Janeshwar Mishra Park, located under the Gomti Nagar Extension police station area, is currently under investigation.

Police stated that preliminary findings suggest the husband and wife had arrived at the park after an argument. During the dispute, the woman allegedly walked away, while the man — said to be under the influence of alcohol — lay down on the road. According to police, the guard attempted to remove him, and the video of that incident later went viral.

Officials said CCTV footage is being examined and statements are being collected from park authorities and on-duty staff. No formal complaint has been lodged at the local police station so far. Further action will be taken based on the investigation findings.

#Lucknow #JaneshwarMishraPark #ViralVideo #UPPolice

articles.title: “Spit Rotis” Row in Mumbai: Viral Video From Goregaon Hotel Sparks Outrage, FIR Filed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking video allegedly showing a hotel employee spitting on roti dough before placing it inside a tandoor at a hotel in Mumbai’s Goregaon area has triggered massive outrage on social media and prompted police action.

body.html:
A shocking video allegedly showing a hotel employee spitting on roti dough before placing it inside a tandoor at a hotel in Mumbai’s Goregaon area has triggered massive outrage on social media and prompted police action.

Mumbai Police have registered an FIR against the accused roti maker, identified as Kausar Ghaffar Sheikh, and the hotel owner, Faiyyaz Ahmad Sheikh. Both have been booked under relevant provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act and sections of the Indian Penal Code.

The incident reportedly took place at Fish Koliwada Hotel located in Santosh Nagar, Goregaon East. The video, which began circulating widely on social media on May 27, appears to show the employee allegedly spitting on rotis before baking and serving them to customers. The footage sparked widespread criticism, with many raising concerns over hygiene standards and public health.

According to the complaint filed by 48-year-old Deepak Dattaram Pawar, he had gone out for dinner on the night of May 23, 2026. After finding another hotel crowded, he visited Fish Koliwada Hotel in the area.

Pawar alleged that while inside the hotel, he noticed the employee allegedly spitting on each roti before placing it inside the furnace for baking. Suspicious about the act, he reportedly stood there for some time and secretly recorded the incident on his mobile phone.

He later showed the video to local residents, leading to anger and protests in the area. According to reports, residents informed the police control room on the night of May 25, following which Mumbai Police reached the spot and detained the accused employee for questioning.

During interrogation, the accused was identified as 53-year-old Kausar Ghaffar Sheikh, a resident of Ballia district in Uttar Pradesh.

Local residents also accused hotel owner Faiyyaz Ahmad Sheikh of negligence, alleging that such acts pose a serious threat to public health.

Police said an investigation is underway and the authenticity of the viral video is also being verified.

The incident has once again raised serious concerns over food safety practices at eateries and the need for strict adherence to hygiene regulations.

#Mumbai #Goregaon #ViralVideo #FoodSafety #MumbaiPolice

articles.title: I Sold Land To Make Her A Teacher’: Husband Alleges Affair After Catching BPSC Teacher With Lover
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A family dispute involving a BPSC teacher and her husband has triggered widespread discussion on social media after the husband accused his wife of having an extramarital affair and abandoning their 13-year marriage.

body.html:
A family dispute involving a BPSC teacher and her husband has triggered widespread discussion on social media after the husband accused his wife of having an extramarital affair and abandoning their 13-year marriage.

The matter came to light after a video of a heated argument between the couple surfaced online. The incident reportedly took place on May 25 in Hajipur, Bihar.

Aman Kumar, 46, a resident of Ward No. 13 under Bidupur police station area, alleged that he caught his wife Gunjan Kumari, 40, in a rented house in Lichchavi Nagar with her alleged lover Prakash.

According to Aman, he married Gunjan in 2013 and financially supported her education despite poor economic conditions. He claimed he worked day and night as a photographer and even sold ancestral land in 2022 to help her complete her studies and prepare for BPSC examinations.

Gunjan was later selected as a teacher in the BPSC TRE-2 recruitment process in December 2023 and was posted at a school in Supaul after training in 2024.

Aman alleged that during her posting in Supaul, Gunjan came into contact with her former college friend Prakash and the two later developed a relationship.

He further claimed that he rented a fully furnished 2BHK accommodation for her near the school and arranged all facilities including AC, refrigerator and washing machine, while he stayed in Vaishali for work.

According to Aman, his suspicion grew after his son informed him that an “uncle” frequently visited the house in his absence. He alleged that his wife instructed the child to identify the man as his maternal uncle if questioned.

The husband also alleged that in January 2025, Gunjan falsely told him she was travelling to Darjeeling with female colleagues, but later he discovered she had not gone with them.

Aman claimed that on May 25, after receiving information about his wife’s location, he reached the rented house in Hajipur and allegedly found Gunjan and Prakash together in an objectionable condition. He said he locked the room from outside and called Dial 112, but before police arrived, locals and the landlord opened the door.

He also alleged that his mobile phone was snatched during the incident and claimed he possesses videos related to the matter.

The couple’s child also made allegations against his mother in front of local residents, claiming that an unknown man regularly visited the house.

The dispute has now reached court, with Aman stating that he has filed cases and submitted evidence supporting his allegations. Gunjan Kumari has not publicly responded to the claims so far.

Police said legal action will be taken if a formal complaint is filed by either party.

The case has also reignited discussion around extramarital affairs and marriage laws in India. In 2018, the Supreme Court, in the Joseph Shine vs Union of India case, struck down Section 497 of the IPC, decriminalising adultery.

However, under civil laws such as the Hindu Marriage Act, extramarital affairs can still be cited as grounds for divorce, alimony disputes and claims related to mental cruelty.

#Bihar #Hajipur #BPSC #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Female Constable Creates Chaos On Delhi-Bound Bus In Jalaun
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A female constable allegedly created chaos in Uttar Pradesh’s Jalaun district after insisting on boarding a Delhi-bound Shatabdi bus despite no seats being available, causing inconvenience to passengers for several hours.

body.html:
A female constable allegedly created chaos in Uttar Pradesh’s Jalaun district after insisting on boarding a Delhi-bound Shatabdi bus despite no seats being available, causing inconvenience to passengers for several hours.

The incident took place on Tuesday evening in the Orai police station area when a Shatabdi bus operated by Amar Travels was leaving for Delhi as part of a tourist package. The bus was reportedly fully occupied with passengers.

According to eyewitnesses, the female constable boarded the bus and insisted on travelling to Delhi. Bus staff allegedly tried to stop her, citing the unavailability of seats, but she refused to get down.

Passengers claimed that the constable engaged in a heated argument with the bus employees and allegedly cited her uniform during the confrontation.

As the situation escalated, the bus driver informed the local police. Even after police personnel reached the spot, the constable allegedly continued the argument for a long time.

Due to the incident, the bus remained stranded for a considerable period, causing major inconvenience to passengers travelling to Delhi.

People present at the scene recorded videos of the incident, which are now rapidly going viral on social media.

Jalaun Superintendent of Police Vinay Kumar Singh said the matter is under investigation and legal action will be taken if the female constable is found guilty.

#Jalaun #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #DelhiBus #BreakingNews
